summary: Writes CHOP channel data to raw ASCII .chan files, either on demand or at a frame interval.
key_concepts: Writes CHOP channel data to .chan files, which are raw ASCII channel files with one row of numbers per frame.
Active writes repeatedly at the specified frame Interval, while Write records a single frame on demand.
The File parameter must be a valid output path before Active is enabled in generated plans.
Channel names are generated automatically in the .chan file, and Scope limits which channels are written.
common_gotchas: File Out CHOP writes .chan channel files, not arbitrary audio or movie formats.
Active mode can append or overwrite frequently depending on file usage; check the target path before show playback.
Interval is in frames, so timeline frame rate affects write timing.
Writing every frame can create large log files quickly.
Use a stable filename and filesystem location before enabling Active in generated plans.
